n: Cafe Hakoniwa, Motobu (Cafe ハコニワ)
address: 2566 Izumi, Motobu-chō, Kunigami District, Okinawa, Japan
w: A 50-plus-year-old house in the Izumi hills, turned into a café with antique furniture. The signature is the Hakoniwa plate, home-style rice and side dishes made with locally grown vegetables. There are also cakes and shīkwāsā juice. Closed Wednesdays and Thursdays.

dish: Kokuu plate (10+ kinds of organic island vegetables)
n: Cafe Kokuu, Nakijin (カフェこくう)
address: 2031-138 Moroshi, Nakijin-son, Kunigami District, Okinawa, Japan
w: A hilltop café in Nakijin whose cooking draws on Japanese and macrobiotic food. The signature Kokuu plate serves more than ten kinds of organically grown island vegetables, each cooked a different way, on yachimun pottery. Closed Sundays and Mondays.

dish: Ie Rum Santa Maria (agricole rum made from Ie-jima sugarcane juice)
n: Iejima Distillery, Ie Island (伊江島蒸留所)
address: 1627-3 Higashi-Ebusaki, Ie-son, Kunigami District, Okinawa, Japan
w: The island's rum distillery, set up in a former bioethanol demonstration plant, makes Ie Rum Santa Maria as agricole rum from local sugarcane juice. It won Best Japanese Rum of the Year at the first Tokyo Whiskey & Spirits Competition in 2019. A distillery-limited bottling took a top gold medal in the 2026 edition. The island is a 30-minute ferry ride from Motobu Port.

dish: Yushi-dōfu Kariyushi set (soft just-set tofu, rice/porridge, okara, soy milk)
n: Tōfu no Higa, Ishigaki (とうふの比嘉)
w: A family tofu maker of more than 70 years, now run by the third generation, that opens at 6:30 am and sells out before noon. It is known for yushi-dōfu, tofu ladled out before it sets. The Kariyushi set adds egg, rice or porridge, okara and soy milk. Closed Sundays.

dish: Marukami soba (homemade noodles, bonito broth, pork belly, nankotsu sōki, egg crepe)
n: Okinawa Soba Marukami, Miyako (沖縄そば まるかみ)
w: A soba shop in the Kizama settlement, run by a former hotel-restaurant cook. The house Marukami soba comes with homemade fresh noodles and bonito broth, topped with seasoned pork belly, tender cartilage sōki and a thin egg crepe. A plain su-soba is also on the menu. Lunch only, 11:00–14:30.
